text: じゃくてんを　せめると　いいのは　じじつだ！

structure.jp: じゃくてんを　せめると　いいのは
structure.en: that it's good to attack weak points

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb plus と いい says that doing it is a good idea. せめると いい = 'it's good to attack'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の wraps up everything before it into one thing you can talk about, like 'the fact that'. せめると いいのは = 'that attacking is good'.
